categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the precision metal components sector, serving industries such as 3C (computer, communication, consumer electronics), automotive, electric tools, and photovoltaic diamond wire busbars. Its product portfolio includes precision springs, stamping parts, metal injection molding (MIM) parts, turned parts, connectors, sunroof drive tubes, and assembly components. The company also produces diamond wire busbars used in photovoltaic silicon wafer cutting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered multiple core precision metal forming technologies including fine wire forming, high-precision turning and milling composite forming, metal insert injection molding, metal powder injection molding, high-speed continuous stamping, 3D tube bending, and micron-level metal wet drawing. It also possesses proprietary technologies such as high-precision shaped spring forming, fatigue-resistant coil spring forming and testing, high-precision metal injection molding control, and high-precision diamond micro-busbar drawing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in downstream industries including consumer electronics (e.g., Makita, Stanley Black & Decker, Bosch), automotive manufacturers (including new energy vehicle sectors), and electric tool manufacturers. The company serves global markets with a focus on China’s domestic market and exports mainly to bonded zones and overseas subsidiaries of multinational clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Jiangsu Province (Kunshan and Nantong). It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for international trade. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and export markets, including bonded zones and overseas branches of multinational customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain as a precision metal components manufacturer supplying customized parts to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in electronics, automotive, and electric tools. It also engages in upstream activities such as producing brass wire for its photovoltaic busbar products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on intelligent manufacturing upgrades and independent new material development. It emphasizes R&D investment to enhance product precision, stability, and yield, targeting emerging sectors like AI-enabled consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, 5G, and IoT. The company actively develops new forming technologies and expands product lines to increase value-added components and assemblies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision metal components and photovoltaic busbars to industrial customers. The company follows a direct sales model with orders based on customer contracts and forecasts, producing mainly to order with some stock for stable products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a high-tech precision metal parts manufacturer with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, holding a competitive edge in quality and technology. It has established long-term partnerships with major global brands, enhancing its market position. Competitors include other precision metal component manufacturers serving similar downstream industries, but the company differentiates through advanced technologies and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 991.6 million, a 6.99% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 88.5 million, a decline due to increased costs and financial expenses. Total assets grew 45.04% to RMB 3.33 billion, supported by convertible bond financing. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong technological foundation, advanced precision forming processes, and high-quality product standards to deliver customized, high-precision metal components with excellent stability and yield. Its ability to rapidly respond to customer needs, innovate in product design and manufacturing, and maintain cost competitiveness provides differentiated value to clients in demanding industries such as consumer electronics, automotive, and photovoltaics.
